findings.title: Image Missing Alternative Text (WCAG 1.1.1)
findings.plainEnglishCause: An element does not have an 'alt' attribute. Screen readers cannot describe the image to visually impaired users.
findings.technicalDetails: Found 1 element(s) without an alt attribute.

fixSteps.instruction: Add a descriptive 'alt' attribute to the tag, or alt="" if the image is purely decorative.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) Header
findings.plainEnglishCause: No Content-Security-Policy header was detected. Without a CSP, the application is vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), clickjacking, and rogue script injection.

fixSteps.instruction: [Stack not detected — generic fix shown, verify against your actual server] Configure a restrictive Content Security Policy specifying trusted script, style, image, and connect origins.
fixSteps.codeSnippet: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https:; connect-src 'self' https:;

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header (Clickjacking Risk)
findings.plainEnglishCause: The page does not set X-Frame-Options, allowing third-party malicious sites to embed your pages inside an iframe and trick users into clicking hidden buttons (clickjacking).

fixSteps.instruction: [Stack not detected — generic fix shown, verify against your actual server] Send X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN or DENY on all HTML responses.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
findings.plainEnglishCause: Browsers may attempt MIME-type sniffing on responses lacking 'nosniff', which can lead to executable script execution from user-uploaded images or text files.

fixSteps.instruction: [Stack not detected — generic fix shown, verify against your actual server] Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on all responses.

findings.title: Missing robots.txt File
findings.plainEnglishCause: No robots.txt file was found at the root of the domain. Having a robots.txt allows you to direct crawler traffic and specify sitemap locations.

fixSteps.instruction: Create a public/robots.txt file at the root of your web server.

findings.title: High Total Blocking Time (TBT > 600ms)
findings.plainEnglishCause: Long-running JavaScript tasks blocked the main browser thread for over 600ms, delaying user interactivity and responsiveness.

fixSteps.instruction: Code-split heavy bundles with dynamic imports, defer analytics scripts, and break up heavy loops.
